title: Gecko

description.en: A little perspective on your screen time, with a Mac tracker and a synced dashboard.
description.zh: 用 Mac 时间追踪器和同步仪表盘，看看自己的时间花在了哪里。

websiteSource: Owner-confirmed Railway deployment, 2026-09-12; public /api/live verified in docs/sources/status-targets-2026-09-12.json
subject: Original sandstone-colored gecko with a complete curled tail and toes

source.description: macOS menu bar screen time tracker with cloud-synced dashboard

subject.en: Original sandstone-colored gecko with a complete curled tail and toes
subject.zh: 保留原样的砂岩色壁虎，卷尾和脚趾完整可见

description.en: The liked whole gecko keeps its exact native placement, broad face, curled tail and spread toes. The comparison intentionally shows the same animal.
description.zh: 喜爱的壁虎全身保留原有位置、宽脸、卷尾和展开的脚趾，前后对比有意展示同一个主体。

description.en: Warm sandstone, clay, cream and quiet sage facets remain byte for byte unchanged. No redraw or new accessory is introduced.
description.zh: 温暖的砂岩、陶土、奶油与柔和鼠尾草色色面逐字节保留，没有重绘或添加新的装饰。

description.en: Staggered broad ledges and short rising seams sit on a warmer clay field. The low relief gives the gecko a distinct place within the family.
description.zh: 错落的宽阔层架和短竖缝铺在暖陶土色底纹上，用浅浮雕为壁虎形成独有的家族背景。

palette.source: Selected Gecko presentation, 2026-09-07-01/01; background.base in archived settings.json

sizeNote.en: The original 2048 px foreground and placement are retained exactly. Existing nearest rounded-outline clearance is 114.5 px with no clipped pixels. Fine facets and small sparks simplify at 16 px; app and browser marks use the transparent source.
sizeNote.zh: 原有 2048 px 透明主体与位置保持完全一致，距圆角轮廓最近处为 114.5 px，没有像素被裁掉。细小切面与电光在 16 px 时会简化，小型 UI 与浏览器使用透明主体。

goal.en: Record app and window usage on a Mac, review daily activity in a synced web dashboard, and optionally generate an AI-assisted daily review.
goal.zh: 记录 Mac 上的应用和窗口使用时间，在同步后的 Web 控制台回看每日活动，并按需生成 AI 每日回顾。

role.zh: Web 页面与 Node.js 服务

role.en: Synced data over the REST API
role.zh: 通过 REST API 存储同步数据

description.en: Staggered sandstone ledges and short rising seams recall the surfaces beneath the gecko’s toes.
description.zh: 错层的砂岩台面与短短的纵向接缝，呼应壁虎脚趾攀附的岩面。

alt.en: Original sandstone-colored gecko with a complete curled tail and toes on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 保留原样的砂岩色壁虎，卷尾和脚趾完整可见，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

description.en: Sandstone-colored gecko with a complete curled tail and toes.
description.zh: 砂岩色壁虎，卷尾和脚趾完整可见。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥75px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 75px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
